claim: ADR 0299 rule 1 (AW29 / A-025, analytics walk 2026-10-03). On hand counts the open bottle at every site that states a stockout risk: engine bottlesOnHand = sealed + open_ml / bottle size, the size COALESCE(bottle_size_ml, 750) as record_glass_pour pours it (a size of 0 or less converts nothing). getInventoryScience (loadInventory) and Wine-360 (loadInventoryWithCost) read inventory_lot_rollup.open_ml and restaurant_inventory.bottle_size_ml and pass bottles, not the sealed qty, as on hand. The insight bundle reads open_ml (readOpenMl) and bottle_size_ml, and computeInventoryFamily returns silently when that read failed (openMlByInventory null). Before: Pierre Ferrand held 950 of 1,000 ml and read 0 bottles. Evidence: apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/stockout-counts-open-ml.spec.ts (13 of 14 cases fail on the tree before the fix).

claim: ADR 0299 rules 2-4. A stockout probability, reorder point, safety stock and CV are stated only for a series with MIN_DEMAND_DAYS = 14 days with a sale in the zero-filled window (engine restockReading); below it they are null, and the row is listed only when on hand <= mean x lead time at a service level whose z >= 0. The register, Wine-360 and the stockout #1 insight all read restockReading, and the insight ranks only measured wines. Sweep: no non-spec .ts under apps/api-gateway/src other than engine/inventory-science.ts calls stockoutProbability( directly. Before: every Tuzlu wine sold on one import day read 0.6098 (CV sqrt 90), and one such wine alone printed as the stockout #1.

claim: ADR 0299 rule 5. The restock export and page give the reason for a missing risk: a row with days of cover but no risk reads sold on fewer than N days in the window (N = params.minDemandDays), a row with no cover keeps no measured demand. When a listed row has no risk, both say the order (highest measured risk first, then the fewest days of cover); the page draws no bars when no listed row has a risk. ADR 0272 bars expression is kept byte-identical.
